added_lines: Jesus is both a loving shepherd and a just ruler. He calls his followers to serve others and live in a way that leads to eternal life, by following his example of love, mercy, and justice. His kingdom is not about power or wealth but about serving others and doing what is right. “Whatever you did for one of the least brothers of mine, you did for me.” (Matthew 25:40) Ballindine (Kilvine)

Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat 11th-13th December 2026 Calling young people aged 16–35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops. Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland." Eucharistic Adoration in Ballindine Church on Monday 23rd November 6pm to 7pm. All are welcome . Christ The King - by Malcolm Guite Our King is calling from the hungry furrows Whilst we are cruising through the aisles of plenty, Our hoardings screen us from the man of sorrows, Our soundtracks drown his murmur: ‘I am thirsty’. He stands in line to sign in as a stranger And seek a welcome from the world he made, We see him only as a threat, a danger, He asks for clothes, we strip-search him instead. And if he should fall sick then we take care That he does not infect our private health, We lock him in the prisons of our fear Lest he unlock the prison of our wealth. But still on Sunday we shall stand and sing The praises of our hidden Lord and King.

CHURCH CLOSING TIME: church will close at the earlier time of 6pm on weekdays, starting from the first week of Advent.
GROW IN LOVE: Communion & Reconciliation continues at the 7.30pm Mass this Saturday evening 14th November.

The theme this month is: In November, We Remember, and this means introducing the children to the different ways in which, during this month, our parish family remembers and prays for those who have died.
CHILDREN the 10am Mass. All children aged between 4 and 8 are invited into the Sacristy for prayer, crafts and a child the liturgy.
Our focus this week is on the Gospel story of Matthew, and we will talk about our talents and how we can share them with others.
STATIONS hosted at the Western Care Community Home next Saturday morning 21st November at 10am. Everyone welcome.
As this year marks the 60th anniversary of Western Care, anyone who has supported or been involved in the organisation over the years is very welcome to attend this celebration also.
NOVEMBER REMEMBRANCE MASS: Remembrance Mass will take place next
Saturday 21st November at 7.30pm. We will remember in a special way parishioners who have died during the past year, as well as praying for all whose names are included in the November altar lists.

FUNERAL MINISTRY: continue their next phase of training, along with Funeral Ministry teams in the Claremorris & Dunmore Deaneries, in Ballyhaunis Community Hall on Mondays 16th & 23rd November from 7.30pm to 9.30pm, with tea/ coffee available from 7pm. CALLED TO SERVE: Parish Ministry Day
Saturday 21st November from 10am to 3pm at St. John Knock.

A day of encouragement, practical ideas and inspiration for anyone involved in parish ministry, including Ministers of the Eucharist & Word, sacristans, choir members, those involved in youth ministry and sensory Mass.
All welcome. For details, email
